indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, delayed-start; ~24 NMAS patients aged 12+ with COL4A3/4/5 LoF NM; 2:1 exaluren:placebo for 16 weeks then placebo crosses to exaluren for additional 16 weeks
indications.trial_status: Not yet recruiting (planned start H1 2026; topline mid-2027, final readout end-2027); FDA IND allowed; UK MHRA CTA obtained; FDA Orphan Drug Designation
